source.title: Feralas Mission IX: Recover Harpy Screed
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Ruins of Ravenwind. Retrieve a harpy Screed and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover a Harpy Screed in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion from the southwestern gazebo at the Ruins of Ravenwind and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
